description: This file defines an Angular component 'ReadingsPageComponent' responsible for displaying and managing readings associated with equipment. It includes methods for loading equipment data, refreshing readings, parsing input values, handling user interactions, and submitting new readings via an API service.

classes.name: ReadingsPageComponent
classes.description: An Angular component for managing the readings entry and display page related to manufacturing equipment.

methods.name: loadEquipment
methods.description: Loads equipment list from API and initializes selected equipment if not already set.

methods.name: refreshReadings
methods.description: Fetches current readings from the API based on selected equipment filter.

methods.name: parseOptionalNumber
methods.description: Converts raw input into a number or undefined, handling empty or invalid input.

methods.name: onEquipmentChange
methods.description: Handles change event for equipment selection.

methods.name: onTimestampChange
methods.description: Handles change in the timestamp input.

methods.name: onNotesChange
methods.description: Handles change in the notes input.

methods.name: onTemperatureChange
methods.description: Updates temperature reading in form state.

methods.name: onVibrationChange
methods.description: Updates vibration reading in form state.

methods.name: onRuntimeChange
methods.description: Updates runtime hours in form state.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits the new reading data to the API and resets form fields upon success.
